name: iwasawa_main_conjecture_constraint_canonical
description: Iwasawa Main Conjecture: char(X) = (f_p) constraints on Λ-modules

test_char_ideal_structure.description: characteristic ideal of Z_p[[T]]-module M is nonzero principal ideal
test_char_ideal_structure.detail: Λ = Z_p[[T]]; characteristic ideal gen(f_p) is admissible for Iwasawa module X

test_finite_proj_dim_implies_char.description: finite projective dimension implies characteristic ideal is nonunit

test_lambda_invariant_count.description: λ-invariant equals number of zeros of characteristic power series
test_lambda_invariant_count.detail: λ = multiplicity of T in char(X) under Z_p[[T]] evaluation

test_nonzero_rank_unit_char_unsat.description: rank(X) > 0 AND char_ideal=unit is UNSAT (Main Conjecture forbids)

test_char_contradiction_unsat.description: characteristic ideal cannot be both unit and nonunit

test_lambda_zero.description: λ=0 when characteristic has no T-factor
test_lambda_zero.detail: Boundary case: characteristic power series has no zeros

test_mu_zero_structure.description: μ=0 structure: Λ-module is finitely generated as Z_p-module
test_mu_zero_structure.detail: Boundary: μ-invariant zero means no (Λ/p) summands

test_proj_dim_bounds.description: projective dimension 0 or 1 is valid boundary
